title: Change
alt: The same rug and six chairs appear twice: a circle on the left, two rows on the right.
scene: Two side by side overhead views of the same bright rug and six small chairs. Left chairs in a circle; right the same six chairs rearranged into two rows of three. Same room and rug. No people.
prompt: Use case: educational child-friendly illustration. Bright, simple flat artwork with large clear shapes, light ivory background, friendly to six-year-olds. Square single concept composition. Two side by side overhead views of the same bright rug and six small chairs. Left chairs in a circle; right the same six chairs rearranged into two rows of three. Same room and rug. No people. Children visibly differ in skin tone, hair and build. No adult towering over a child, pointing, shaming or dominating. No prohibition signs, red slashes or crossed-out symbols. Absolutely no words, letters, numerals, writing, captions, labels, logos or watermark; paper and walls must be blank. The native application will add editable captions.
